_doc: Title key art for tools/illustrate.py keyart. Cast lines are built from overrides.json at the given range start (early, spoiler-free looks) so faces match the portraits. Composition follows key-visual practice: one clear focal character, supporting cast smaller and behind, asymmetric placement, clean high-contrast title area, a single readable story idea.
title: Murim Login
style: Semi-realistic Korean webtoon (manhwa) key art, wuxia murim world inspired by Ming-dynasty China, clean linework, painterly shading, soft cinematic lighting, ink-wash atmosphere in muted warm tones

murim-login-key-art-1.idea: The login: a triangle ensemble on a misty mountain sect terrace, with a faint game interface dissolving into ink-wash mist around the hero's raised hand.
murim-login-key-art-1.scene: a stone terrace of a mountain sect high above a sea of clouds, curved temple rooftops and jagged ink-wash peaks behind, dawn light from the upper left
murim-login-key-art-1.composition: vertical 2:3 poster. Jin Taekyung is the focal point: large in the lower-middle foreground, slightly off-centre to the right, three-quarter body, one hand raised as if pressing a floating button. Behind him at mid-distance, smaller: Hyuk Mujin to the right with a sword at his hip, Cheongpung to the left; Jeok Cheongang, small and slight, sits on a rock ledge above and behind them, watching. A translucent, minimal blue game-interface window (thin frame, a progress bar, no readable words) floats beside Jin's hand and dissolves into ink-wash mist and drifting embers. Top third: open misty sky left clear for the title
murim-login-key-art-1.title_placement: large, centred in the top third over the misty sky: bold hand-brushed calligraphic Latin letters in deep ink black with a subtle warm-gold edge, with a thin glowing digital underline like a login cursor

murim-login-key-art-2.idea: The crossing: a split world. A modern Seoul night below, the murim mountains above, joined by a glowing login portal that Jin steps through.
murim-login-key-art-2.scene: the image is split by a glowing rectangular game-window portal: the lower fifth is a modern Seoul apartment rooftop at night with blurred city lights and a VR headset lying on the ledge; above the portal rises a sunlit wuxia mountain world with a cliff-top pavilion, pines and drifting clouds
murim-login-key-art-2.composition: vertical 2:3 poster, low camera looking up. Jin Taekyung is the focal point, mid-stride through the portal in the lower half, centred slightly left, full figure, in his murim robe, grinning back over his shoulder at the viewer. In the murim world above and behind him, much smaller: Jeok Cheongang standing small and slight at the cliff edge with his hands behind his back, Hyuk Mujin and Cheongpung on the path below the pavilion. Light from the murim side rims Jin warmly; the city side is cool blue. Keep the dark night-city band at the very bottom clean for the title
murim-login-key-art-2.title_placement: large, centred across the dark bottom band: bold brush-stroke calligraphic Latin letters in warm off-white with faint ember sparks, the second word glowing slightly like a game-interface highlight
